extra_quotes: Our simulation infrastructure builds upon the framework developed for our prior heterogeneous PIM work, HPIM [36], and is extended to model SPIMOE-specific mechanisms.

The SRAM-PIM subsystem is modeled using our in-house CIMFlow framework [37], with digital modules implemented in Verilog HDL and synthesized using Synopsys Design Compiler at 12 nm for area and power estimation.

The HBM-PIM subsystem follows the bank-level PIM organization of Newton [ 30] and is modeled using an extended DRAMsim3 [38] under the HBM3 specification [39]; its PUs and global buffers are also synthesized at 12 nm.
The 4 × 8 mesh NoC is modeled using an extended Noxim [40].
